The problem

AI fills the gaps by guessing

AI is powerful, but without real context about you, it fills the gaps by guessing. That's where hallucinations come from: confident answers built on missing or wrong information. The fix isn't a better prompt. It's better context.

What the Living Compass does

Your context brain

In 30 days, you'll have a context brain, an organized and accurate record of your story, your goals and how you work. You keep building it from there. Your AI draws on facts you've given it instead of filling in blanks, so its answers stay grounded in who you really are.

Design your life, not just your week

The Living Compass helps you see where your attention actually goes, compared with what matters most to you. That awareness is where everything changes. Once you can see it, you can start handing the routine work to AI and give your time back to the things that matter.

Benefits
  • Fewer hallucinations, because the AI is working from your real information
  • Clarity about what you really want, written down in one place
  • A brain that stays current on its own schedule, with no extra work on your part
  • A foundation you own that carries into everything you build next

Keeping it accurate, without the homework

Logbook Checks in with you

Logbook checks in with you at the right moments with a quick question or two about what happened, what you learned and what's changed. You just answer, and your brain stays current.

Course correction Weekly

Once a week, Course correction checks in for a short heading check covering what worked, what drifted and what to adjust. It comes to you, so your direction stays true without you having to remember.

Next stop · Launch Academy

When your foundation is set, Launch Academy turns it into a working business system.
